description: This file defines the AiCategorizer class which provides AI-powered categorization and suggestion functionalities for files, based on heuristics such as file name and type.

classes.name: AiCategorizer
classes.description: Provides AI-powered categorization and quick sharing suggestions for files based on heuristics like file name and type.

methods.name: suggestQuickShare
methods.description: Returns a list of FileItem objects representing files suggested for quick sharing, using simple heuristics.

methods.name: categorizeByName
methods.description: Categorizes a file based on its name extension, returning a string label such as 'Photos', 'Videos', etc.
